entity.summary: Historical non-custodial multichain wallet ecosystem formerly branded XDEFI Wallet; normal Ctrl Wallet functionality was shut down in August 2026.
entity.notes: First-party XDEFI/Ctrl material preserves one wallet lineage. Ctrl's 2026-07-07 deprecation notice states permanent shutdown: store distribution ended July 7, normal functionality ended after August 2, and from 2026-08-03 only recovery-phrase export remains. WLR therefore records the wallet entity as dead from the effective shutdown date.

products.summary: Discontinued Ctrl browser wallet extension, continuing the former XDEFI Wallet extension lineage; from 2026-08-03 only recovery-phrase export remains.
products.notes: Selected extension boundary only; Ctrl mobile apps are separate. The 2024 rebrand is not treated as initial extension launch. Ctrl removed the wallet from stores on 2026-07-07, left normal wallet functionality available through 2026-08-02, and from 2026-08-03 disabled wallet features except recovery-phrase export. WLR records the extension as discontinued with support ended.

events.title: Ctrl Wallet shut down normal wallet functionality
events.description: Ctrl announced a permanent shutdown: after removal from app and browser-extension stores on July 7, 2026, normal wallet functionality remained available through August 2 and from August 3 only recovery-phrase export remained while wallet features were disabled.
events.notes: The surviving recovery-phrase export path is a recovery mechanism, not normal wallet operation. The canonical Ctrl entity is therefore corrected to dead and the extension product to discontinued/support ended as of 2026-08-03.

events.title: Ctrl documented Manifest V3 migration for the browser extension
events.description: Ctrl published a first-party migration update stating that the wallet extension would fully comply with Chrome Manifest V3 and that existing XDEFI Wallet users would receive the Ctrl update automatically without moving funds or re-importing wallet keys.

evidence.title: XDEFI Wallet is becoming Ctrl Wallet: discover the new features
evidence.notes: First-party rebrand announcement explicitly establishes XDEFI→Ctrl continuity and states existing wallets automatically update while keys remain locally stored.

evidence.title: Ctrl Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party site states Ctrl is non-custodial and confirms migration of the former XDEFI browser extension to Ctrl.

evidence.title: Ctrl Wallet Deprecation: What You Need to Know
evidence.notes: First-party Ctrl notice states the wallet is permanently shutting down, was removed from stores on July 7, remains normally functional only through August 2, and from August 3 allows only recovery-phrase export while wallet features are disabled.

evidence.title: Understanding Manifest V3 and how Ctrl is prepared
evidence.notes: First-party Ctrl article documents Manifest V3 compliance and automatic migration from the XDEFI Wallet extension to Ctrl.
